title: DropletsRip instance
description: Per-template schema for droplets. Core TemplateConfig fields (theme/global) are $ref-d from the global animations.schema.json. This template does NOT own content — it applies a rainy-glass treatment to arbitrary `children` passed by the caller, so `elements[]` is unconstrained (any id) and typically empty. extras.* are extended here.

elements.description: Currently unused by droplets itself — content is passed as `children` to <DropletsRip>. Kept in the schema for DeepConfig pipeline compatibility.

intensity.description: How much rain falls, from a light drizzle to a downpour

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier. 1 is normal speed

scale.description: Size of the droplet pattern. Higher means smaller drops

dropWidth.description: Width of the droplets and their trails

dropLength.description: How elongated the falling droplets are

refraction.description: How strongly droplets refract the content behind them

blur.description: Background blur outside the droplets, like a fogged up window (mipmap-sampled — no visible content distortion, just softness)

vignette.description: Darkens the edges of the canvas

fallSpeed.description: How fast the running drops slide down

wiggle.description: Horizontal wiggle of the running drops

staticDrops.description: Multiplier for the small static droplets

tint.description: Tint color layered over the content as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range
